observations: Photo 0: Yamaha-branded electronic keyboard; full-size keys visible; control panel with screen/knobs/buttons; no clear model number visible.
Photo 1: Yamaha logo clearly visible on front; orange/black body; speakers/grilles on sides; still no readable model name/number.
Photo 2: Close-up of Yamaha logo and keys; screen area appears present but text is not readable enough to confirm model/specs.

claims.evidence: Photos show a Yamaha keyboard (photos 0-2) but do not show a model/spec sheet or clear proof of being a specific 'professional' class.

risks.risk: Exact Yamaha model is not readable; price varies a lot by model (e.g., PSR E-series vs higher models).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the model name/number label (usually on the back panel or underside) and/or the screen boot-up showing the model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Yamaha portable keyboard with unknown model (worst-case within the comparable range).

risks.risk: Functionality not proven (keys, sound, speakers, screen, buttons).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video: power on + playing several notes + showing volume/speaker output + demonstrating at least 1-2 buttons/tones.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/assume basic functions may be faulty until proven.

risks.proof: Ask what comes with it: power adapter, sustain pedal, stand, headphones; request photos of all included items.
risks.if_unproven: Price as keyboard only (no guaranteed accessories).

risks.risk: Physical condition unknown beyond the front view (cracks, loose keys, damaged casing).
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the underside, both sides, and any ports (DC in, headphone, USB/MIDI if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible cosmetic wear and unknown internal condition.

proof_requests: Photo of the back/underside label showing the exact Yamaha model number (and serial if available).
Video of power-on and a quick performance test (play keys, change tone/setting, confirm speakers).
Photos of included items (power adapter, sustain pedal, stand if any).
Close-ups of ports and underside to check for damage.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a Yamaha keyboard, but the exact model and working condition are not provable from the images provided, so a reliable worst-case price cannot be set without the missing decisive shots.
